name: Gojira
description: French metal giants known for their precise rhythm and heavy, atmospheric soundscapes.

name: Opeth
description: Legendary Swedish band known for blending death metal aggression with 70s prog rock beauty.

name: Black Sabbath
description: The godfathers of heavy metal. Known for creating the genre with slow, heavy, and ominous sounds that explore dark and occult themes.

name: Iron Maiden
description: British legends known for their galloping rhythm, melodic guitar harmonies, and lyrics based on history, literature, and film.

name: Metallica
description: The biggest metal band in history. Pioneers of Thrash Metal, characterized by fast tempos, instrumentals, and aggressive musicianship.

name: Death
description: Pioneers of Death Metal who evolved the genre from raw brutality to sophisticated technicality and philosophical lyrics.

name: System of a Down
description: Armenian-American band known for their unique blend of heavy riffs, melodic vocals, and politically charged lyrics.

name: Korn
description: A pioneering nu-metal band known for their downtuned guitars, aggressive sound, and emotional lyrics dealing with personal struggles.

name: Nightwish
description: A Finnish band that combines heavy metal with movie-score orchestration and operatic vocals, creating a massive fantasy sound.

name: Tool
description: A band known for their complex mathematical rhythms, spiritual lyrics, and visual artistry, creating a trance-like heavy experience.

name: Rammstein
description: German industrial machine known for their marching rhythms, electronic elements, and provocative lyrics.

name: Slipknot
description: A 9-member chaos machine from Iowa, known for their aggressive nu-metal sound, masks, and intense live energy.

name: Lorna Shore
description: Modern extreme metal leaders, mixing massive breakdowns with orchestral elements and vocal techniques that sound inhuman.

name: Sleep Token
description: An anonymous masked collective that blends heavy metal breakdowns with soulful pop, R&B, and atmospheric electronics.

name: Behemoth
description: Polish extreme metal titans known for their blend of black and death metal, with occult themes and symphonic elements.

name: Amon Amarth
description: Swedish melodic death metal band known for their Viking-themed lyrics, melodic guitar work, and powerful growled vocals.

name: Architects
description: British metalcore band known for their energetic performances, emotional lyrics, and blend of heavy breakdowns with melodic elements.

name: Deafheaven
description: An American band that fuses black metal intensity with shoegaze atmospherics, creating a unique and emotional sound.

name: Mastodon
description: An American band known for their complex compositions, heavy sludge riffs, and thematic concept albums.

name: Black Veil Brides
description: An American band known for their theatrical image, anthemic metalcore sound, and emotional lyrics.

name: Disturbed
description: An American band known for their powerful vocals, heavy riffs, and anthemic choruses that blend aggression with melody.

name: Avenged Sevenfold
description: An American band known for their blend of metalcore and hard rock, featuring dual guitar harmonies and melodic vocals.

name: Trivium
description: An American band known for their blend of metalcore and thrash metal, featuring fast riffs and melodic choruses.

name: Drowning Pool
description: An American band known for their heavy riffs, powerful vocals, and anthemic choruses.

name: Five Finger Death Punch
description: An American band known for their heavy riffs, powerful vocals, and anthemic choruses that blend aggression with melody.

name: Mayhem
description: A pioneering Norwegian black metal band known for their raw sound, aggressive style, and dark, satanic themes.

name: In Flames
description: A Swedish band known for their melodic guitar work, dynamic vocals, and themes of dystopia and inner struggles.

name: Cannibal Corpse
description: An American death metal band known for their brutal sound, graphic lyrics, and intense musicianship.

name: Sepultura
description: A Brazilian band known for their heavy riffs, aggressive vocals, and incorporation of tribal percussion into their metal sound.

name: Ghost
description: A Swedish band known for their theatrical stage presence, melodic heavy metal sound, and occult-themed lyrics.

name: Patriarkh
description: Patriarkh is a Polish black metal band with roots in Batushka, which split due to a legal dispute over the band's name. The band's music and lyrics draw inspiration from the Orthodox Church, traditional hymns, songs, history, and regional folklore.

name: Bathory
description: Bathory was a Swedish band formed in 1983 by Quorthon (Thomas Börje Forsberg). They are considered pioneers of both black metal and Viking metal, known for their raw sound, epic compositions, and mythological themes.

name: Mgła
description: Mgła is a Polish black metal band formed in 2000 by M. (Mikołaj Żentara) and Darkside (Maciej Kowalski). Known for their atmospheric sound, melancholic melodies, and introspective lyrics, Mgła has gained a significant following in the black metal community.

name: Emperor
description: Emperor is a Norwegian black metal band formed in 1991 by Ihsahn (Vegard Sverre Tveitan) and Samoth (Tomas Thormodsæter Haugen). They are known for their complex compositions, symphonic elements, and dark, mythological themes.

name: Darkthrone
description: Darkthrone is a Norwegian black metal band formed in 1986 by Fenriz (Gylve Fenris Nagell) and Nocturno Culto (Ted Skjellum). They are considered pioneers of the true Norwegian black metal scene, known for their raw sound, lo-fi production, and minimalistic approach.

name: Burzum
description: Burzum is a Norwegian black metal project formed in 1991 by Varg Vikernes. Known for its raw sound, atmospheric elements, and introspective lyrics, Burzum has been influential in the black metal scene.

name: Dark Funeral
description: Dark Funeral is a Swedish black metal band formed in 1993 by Lord Ahriman (Mikael Svanberg) and Blackmoon (David Parland). Known for their aggressive style, satanic themes, and raw sound, Dark Funeral has been a prominent figure in the black metal scene.

name: Dream Theater
description: An American band known for their complex compositions, technical proficiency, and epic concept albums that blend metal and progressive rock.

name: Judas Priest
description: A legendary British band known for their twin guitar harmonies, powerful vocals, and anthemic choruses that helped define the heavy metal genre.

name: Megadeth
description: An American band known for their fast riffs, complex guitar solos, and politically charged lyrics that address themes of war, corruption, and society. Pioneers of the thrash metal genre.

name: Helloween
description: A German band known for their fast riffs, melodic vocals, and epic song structures that helped define the power metal genre.

name: Slayer
description: An American band known for their fast riffs, aggressive vocals, and dark lyrics that often explore themes of Satanism, war, and death. Pioneers of the thrash metal genre.

name: Municipal Waste
description: Municipal Waste is the definitive face of the crossover thrash revival. Their sound seamlessly blends the raw intensity of hardcore punk with the technical speed of 80s thrash metal. Fast, fun, and relentlessly energetic, their music is built for moshing, characterized by razor-sharp riffs and an infectious party atmosphere.
